decisions.reason: s0007 尋遷儀同 names the honorific Yitong (儀同三司), not 侍中 Palace Attendant of the First Rank; the proposed office is accurate.
The same 儀同 in s0007 is Yitong in the literal field, not Palace Attendant of the First Rank.
s0009 擊尉迥於相州 names the AD 580 Xiangzhou rebel Yuchi Jiong (尉遲迥, abbreviated 尉迥), not Yuwen Yong (宇文邕).
Literal s0009 likewise has 尉迥; Yuchi Jiong is the correct English name, not Yuwen Yong.
s0014 遣儀同樊子蓋 gives Fan Zigai the rank 儀同, not 侍中 Palace Attendant.
Literal s0014 repeats 儀同樊子蓋; Yitong is the source rank.
s0028 追錄前功 is a living retrospective record of merit, and s0029 still has Yan on campaign, so 'posthumously' is false; 'again recorded his earlier merit' matches 複追錄前功.
s0029 十八年，遼東之役 is a reign year then the Liaodong campaign, not year eighteen of that campaign.
s0038 開府儀同三司 is Kaifu Yitong Sansi, not 金紫光祿大夫 Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
Literal s0038 has the same 開府儀同三司; Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon is the wrong office.
s0043 儀同苟子溢 is Yitong Gou Ziyi, not Palace Attendant (侍中).
Literal s0043 likewise mistranslates 儀同 as Palace Attendant; Yitong is correct.
s0055 授開府儀同三司 is the palatine rank, not 金紫光祿大夫; Palatine Unequalled in Honor is an accurate rendering.
The literal line copies the same false Golden Seal office for 開府儀同三司.
s0056 高祖為丞相 names Gaozu as Northern Zhou chief minister and does not call him 帝; adding 'Emperor' is anachronistic in this dating clause.
s0057 公父子忠良 names father and son; 'Your house' drops the individuated father that the Chinese addresses.
s0066 光州刺史 is Guang Prefecture (光州), a Huainan posting against Chen, not 廣州 Guangzhou.
Literal s0066 has the same 光州; Guang Prefecture avoids the 廣州 conflation.
s0092 子士廉，最知名 names one renowned son and does not mention descendants; that frame is invented.
s0093 juxtaposes the graphic variants 爾朱敞 and 爾硃敞 for one man; doubling the English name as if two given names is wrong.
s0114 南光州 is southern Guang Prefecture, not Guangzhou (廣州).
Literal s0114 has the same 南光州; southern Guang Prefecture is the source place.
s0148 獨孤楷，字修則 names him once; the lemma-plus-opener doubling is not in the Chinese.
s0157 上征之，猶豫未發 is the summons followed by delay in setting out, and s0159 乃就路 shows Xiu as the one who finally departed, not the emperor hesitating.
s0172 乞伏慧，字令和 names him once; the doubled English lemma is not in the Chinese.
s0177 開府儀同大將軍 does not mention a golden seal or purple ribbon; removing that invented phrase is required.

decisions.after: While Gaozu was chief minister, he followed Wei Xiaokuan against Yuchi Dun at Wuzhi, was victorious in every engagement, was made Grand General, and received eight hundred bolts of goods.

decisions.after: That year he was demoted to prefect of Qizhou in Henan; after several years he was transferred to regional commander of Xuzhou.

English geographic qualifiers disambiguate the homophonous prefecture names without embedding Chinese text in the English replacement.
s0199 張威，不知何許人也 names him once; the lemma-plus-sentence doubling is not in the Chinese.

s0227 和洪，汝南人也 names him once; the doubled English lemma is not in the Chinese.
s0229 儀同三司 is Equal to the Three Excellencies, not Palace Attendant of the Third Rank (a false 侍中 reading).
Literal s0229 has the same 儀同三司; Equal to the Three Excellencies is the source rank.
s0237 尉迥作亂相州 names Yuchi Jiong, not Yuwen Yong.
Literal s0237 likewise has 尉迥; Yuchi Jiong is the rebel, not Yuwen Yong.
s0238 迥遣兵 continues 尉迥; the subject is Jiong, not Yong.
Literal s0238 迥遣兵 is Jiong sending troops, not Yong.
s0239 尉惇 is Yuchi Dun, not Yuwen Dun.
Literal s0239 repeats 尉惇; Yuchi Dun is the correct surname.
s0246 侯莫陳穎，字遵道 names him once; the doubled English lemma is not in the Chinese.
s0250 開府儀同三司 is the kaifu honorary office, not 金紫光祿大夫 Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
Literal s0250 has the same 開府儀同三司; Commander Unequaled in Honor is an accurate replacement for the false Golden Seal office.
